'''2008 Quebec Provincial Championship''' was an eight-player [[Cube|cube draft]] tournament held on 24 May 2008 at Le Chevalier.<ref name="report">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303824 Trooper Shark's Quebec Provincial Championship tourney repor], trooper shark, Players Committee Forums (27 May 2008).</ref>

== Event details ==

* '''Date:''' 24 May 2008
* '''Venue:''' Le Chevalier
* '''Format:''' [[Cube|Cube draft]]
* '''Players:''' 8<ref name="report" />
* '''Day 2 bid:''' [[Marc Renaud]], for the [[2008 World Championship]]<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], Cedric (simone89), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>
